name: didim-mcp
description: Connect Didim MCP with your Microsoft account. The plugin registers the hosted Didim MCP server and Codex handles the OAuth sign-in; no API key is ever entered.

interface.shortDescription: Use Didim MCP tools with your Microsoft account.
interface.longDescription: Registers the hosted Didim MCP server and ships skills for safe tool use and MOLIT apartment trade/rent real-transaction queries. Sign in through Connect with your Microsoft account — Codex runs the OAuth flow for you, so there is no API key to create, copy, or paste. Only the tools you enabled in the Didim portal are exposed.
